## Testing Mode
GREEN

## What
Create tests/scripts/test_bridge_roundtrip.py implementing the full round-trip integration test suite and failure-injection matrix for the 4 silent-drop fixes.

## Acceptance Criteria

### Module-level helpers (not conftest — inline in test file)
- _make_tracker_git_repo(tmp_path: Path, num_commits: int) -> dict: creates a tmp git repo with .tickets-tracker/ structure and N commits each adding one event file; returns {'repo': path, 'commit_shas': [sha1, sha2, ...], 'event_files': [...]}
- _mock_jira_v3_urlopen(adf_description_dict, assignee_accountid): context manager using unittest.mock.patch('urllib.request.urlopen') that returns schema-faithful Jira REST v3 GET response with ADF description dict and accountId

### Round-trip test
- test_roundtrip_description_and_assignee_preserved:
  1. Create tracker with 1 CREATE event (description='Hello', assignee='joe@example.com')
  2. Set BRIDGE_USER_MAP={'joe@example.com': 'acc123'} in os.environ
  3. Run process_events (outbound bridge) with mocked acli_client.create_issue returning {'key': 'PROJ-1'}
  4. Run write_create_events (inbound bridge) with mocked Jira REST v3 GET returning ADF {'type':'doc','version':1,'content':[{'type':'paragraph','content':[{'type':'text','text':'Hello'}]}]} and fields.assignee.displayName='Joe User'
  5. Read the written CREATE event; assert event['data']['description'] contains 'Hello'
  6. Assert event['data']['assignee'] == 'Joe User' (or accountId mapped)

### Shell entry-point test
- test_shell_entrypoint_three_commits_all_reach_jira:
  1. Create tmp git tracker repo with 4 commits (1 setup + 3 CREATE events)
  2. Set .outbound-checkpoint.json to SHA of setup commit (so 3 event commits are in range)
  3. Run process_events() with git_diff_output=None (internal git subprocess runs)
  4. Assert mock_acli.create_issue called 3 times (all 3 commit events reached)
  5. Uses tmp_path for isolation (mktemp pattern, per CLAUDE.md rule 16)

### 4 Failure-injection tests (separate functions, NOT parametrized)
- test_cursor_revert_drops_old_commits: monkeypatch process_events to use HEAD~1..HEAD diff (revert cursor fix); with 3 commits older than HEAD~1, assert only 1 event reaches create_issue (or 0); test MUST FAIL if real process_events is used after S1 fix
- test_env_id_revert_drops_same_env_events: monkeypatch filter_bridge_events to filter out events even when bridge_env_id=''; create CREATE event with env_id=''; assert 0 events reach create_issue (dropped); test MUST FAIL after S2 fix is active
- test_adf_isinstance_revert_drops_description: monkeypatch _adf_to_text to return None for dict input (revert to isinstance str check); run inbound write_create_events with ADF description dict; assert written event['data']['description'] is None; test MUST FAIL after S3 fix is active  
- test_null_assignee_revert_no_bridge_alert: delete AcliClient.unassign_issue attribute (setattr to raise AttributeError); run handle_create_event with no-match BRIDGE_USER_MAP; assert no BRIDGE_ALERT written to __bridge__/ dir; test MUST FAIL after S4 fix is active

### CI integration
- Tests in test_bridge_roundtrip.py are automatically picked up by pytest; verify in CI the test file is within the scope of the existing test run command

## Files to Modify / Create
- tests/scripts/test_bridge_roundtrip.py (new)
